sectorBenchmark.name: Sector SPDR ETF for the company's GICS sector

rules.entry: Close on the first trading day after the lean date (no same-day peeking).
rules.exit: Close on the first trading day at least N calendar days after entry.
rules.hit: Tailwind = right if the stock rose; headwind = right if it fell. 'Beat the market' compares the stock's move with SPY over the same days: a tailwind counts if the stock did better than the S&P 500, a headwind if it did worse. 'Beat its sector' is the same test against the company's sector SPDR ETF (e.g. XLK for tech).
rules.noCall: Mixed and quiet leans aren't calls, so they aren't scored.
rules.liveSampling: Live leans are logged daily; we score the first snapshot of each week per stock so one call isn't counted seven times.

backtest.note: Reconstructed leans, not live calls. Each checkpoint uses only data that was public by that date: Federal Reserve (FRED) series come from ALFRED vintages, i.e. exactly the values published as of the day before the checkpoint, with real release dates and no later revisions; SEC numbers use their first filing date; other sources use conservative publication lags.
